properties.description: Demo: operational starting threshold. Notifications are attached separately (see docs/setup/19-alerts.md).

allOf.query: Perf | where Computer == "HV-HOST-01" and ObjectName == "Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor" and CounterName == "CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch" and InstanceName contains ":" | extend Guest=tostring(split(InstanceName,":")[0]) | where Guest in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") | summarize Value=percentile(CounterValue,95)
